rust_summary: An enchanting table drew an offer's level (`native_enchantment_level_set`).
doc_summary: An enchanting table drew the level of one offer, in `EnchantmentMenu.slotsChanged` after `getEnchantmentCost`: `native_enchantment_level_set(player, player_entity_id, pos, row, power, item, original_level, level)`. `row` is 0 to 2, `power` the bookshelves counted, `original_level` the level drawn; change `level` to change the offer (below `row + 1` offers nothing, as vanilla). The clue shown is the one the new level gives. Asked for each row in order, before `prepare_item_enchant`, for the server player whose table it is. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:enchantment_level_set@.
